text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"Dad collapsed." Upon receiving the urgent 
news, Tamamo Cross returned home 
immediately with her Trainer. There, she 
makes a major decision.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"I'll retire and look after my family." 
However, the ones who stopped her from 
doing so were none other than her family 
themselves.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Learning that it wasn't Tamamo Cross's 
financial support, but the very act of her 
running that brought hope to her family, 
she resolves to keep racing.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Oguri Cap welcomed her at the airport. 
Having thought of Oguri when contemplating 
retirement, she declared she would show 
her a great run at the Takarazuka Kinen.
